summary: Iter154 Execution Observability UI — full backend + frontend E2E testing PASS. critical_code_review_comments: ScalpExecutions.jsx correctly handles empty-state with dedicated data-testid; nested timeline uses per-row testids scalp-exec-timeline-{trade_id} which is clean.

trade_routes.py execution_summary payload gracefully returns nulls for un-evaluated trades — frontend fmtN/'—' fallback works. Consider surfacing reconciliation badges more prominently: on the mostly-null trade the reconciliation subrow (exec-sum-reconciliation) is still rendered but with backfilled_at=null so only the financial_status/pnl chips appear (or nothing). Not a bug.

ExecutionHealthPanel.jsx: feeds_stale > 0 flips exec-feeds chip to amber which is correct; in the test env 5/5 feeds are stale (no tick stream since EA offline) — this reflects true infra state so leave as-is. exec-clock-skew uses skew>30s threshold for amber which matches infra['clock_skew_sec'] naming.
AccountCertification component renders 14 rows in a 3-col grid — verified no wrapping/truncation with the 3 new labels. Icons (green check / red cross) render consistently.

step_up.py gate uses X-Step-Up-Bypass header for the pytest suite; this is fine but be aware raw curl / browser POST /api/bot/start with no MFA on admin (with valid CSRF) will 403 mfa_enrollment_required — good defense-in-depth. Verified in test_iter154 by explicitly clearing the bypass header.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing DB seed. Trades 6a612a5b6936705cbd7c78f3 and 6a61ae5f883889ba6a1a7c0a already present with expected evaluation fields; admin's 6 accounts already in DB with 14 certification checks populated.
